use_when.text: Use Table for every Back Office list, such as reports, users and venues, and handovers.
Start with one Header row, then Body rows with no gap.
Use Body Hover for the row under the pointer.
Keep the same column widths in every row.
Set the width to Fill so the table matches the page.

dont_use_when.text: Do not round the rows. The Table container does the rounding.
Do not put more than one Header row in a table.
Do not put more than one action in the Action column.
Do not use it on mobile. Use Item Card in the List layout.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Sort rows so the newest or most urgent items come first.
Keep cell text short, and show the full value on the item page.

pairs_with.how: One Table Row of Type Header in thead, then Body rows in tbody (five by default, or the children passed)

a11y.text: Renders a native <table> inside a <div>, with aria-label defaulting to "Recent reports".
The Header row is in <thead> and Body rows are in <tbody>.
Has no <caption>; the name is given through aria-label.
Use a table element: thead with th cells for the Header row, tbody with td cells for Body rows.
Give th cells scope="col", and give the table a caption or aria-label, such as "Recent reports".
The Review Link Button should be a link or button whose name includes the item, such as "Review LF-2041".
When cell text is cut off, show the full value on hover and on the item page.
Header labels are 6.1:1 on the green header. Body text is above 4.5:1.

gaps.detail: Table has no variant prop in code (Table.tsx:4-15, 24: "The node has no variant properties"), so there is nothing to describe.
